sn21.1:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
sn21.1:1.3: tatra kho āyasmā mahā moggallāno bhakkhū āmantesi
sn21.1:1.5: āvusoti kho te bhikkhū āyasmato mahāmoggallānassa paccassosuṃ.
sn21.1:2.2: idha mayhaṃ āvuso rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi
sn21.1:2.6: idha bhikkhu vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodi bhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharati
sn21.1:2.8: so khvāhaṃ āvuso vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn21.1:2.9: tassa mayhaṃ āvuso iminā vihārena viharato vitakkasahagatā saññā manasikārā samudācaranti.
sn21.1:3.1: atha kho maṃ āvuso bhagavā iddhiyā upasaṅkamitvā etadavoca
sn21.1:3.2: moggallāna moggallāna mā brāhmaṇa ariyaṃ tuṇhībhāvaṃ pamādo ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ saṇṭhapehi ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ ekodibhāvaṃ karohi ariye tuṇhībhāve cittaṃ samādahāti.
sn21.1:3.3: so khvāhaṃ āvuso aparena samayena vitakka vicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyajjhānaṃ upasampajja viharāmi.
sn21.1:3.4: yaṃ hi āvuso sammā vadamāno vadeyya
sn21.1:3.5: satthārā anuggahito sāvako mahābhiññattaṃ pattoti. mamantaṃ sammā vadamāno vadeyya
